claims: C1: Scopes of autonomy should be recorded in a semi-structured format.
C2: A semi-structured format for a scope of autonomy includes fields for allowed tools, latest time, maximum cost, tool constraints, and additional details.
C3: Recording scopes in this semi-structured format supports validation, enforcement, and auditing by the platform.
